insight.headline: Invalid Metafield Queries
insight.what_changed: The GraphQL Admin API now returns an error when a query filters by a metafield that isn't set up for filtering, instead of silently returning incorrect results. This change is available in API version 2026-10. The API will provide more accurate and reliable results for metafield queries.
insight.developer_impact: Developers should update their code to handle the new error response from the GraphQL Admin API. They should ensure that their metafield queries are correctly set up for filtering to avoid errors. Additionally, developers can use this change to improve the reliability and accuracy of their app's data. They should review their existing code and update it to comply with the new API behavior. The `metafield` query should be used with caution, and developers should verify that the metafield is set up for filtering before querying it.
insight.merchant_impact: Merchants will benefit from more accurate and reliable data in their apps, as the new API behavior will prevent incorrect results from being returned. This change will improve the overall quality of the merchant's experience with the app.
insight.why_it_matters: This change matters because it improves the reliability and accuracy of the GraphQL Admin API, which is a critical component of many Shopify apps. By returning an error for invalid metafield queries, the API helps developers identify and fix issues with their code, resulting in better apps for merchants.

themes.title: Storefront Updates
themes.detail: Standard storefront events and actions now support cart attributes, and WebMCP support has been added for Liquid and Hydrogen storefronts, enabling AI agents to interact with online stores more seamlessly. This update also includes the ability to serve UI extension source maps during app development.

themes.detail: The latest CLI update (4.6.1) includes serving UI extension source maps during app development, enhancing the development experience for Shopify apps built with frameworks like Remix/React Router and utilizing Polaris for UI components.
